label: Direct existential support versus a mediate thinking ground-ancestor
term: source of a thinker's existence under the selected dependence relation
resolution: PresentEsseSupport is an actual direct edge of a separate primitive existential-support relation and does not itself impose distinctness or thinkerhood. ThinkerPredecessor in the #1791 selected reading is a distinct bearer of an occurring thought at the start of a nonempty finite path through ActualConcreteGround. This latter G+ ancestry relation is neither by definition nor by theorem a direct support relation; the P/¬P coverage statement is valid at a fixed selected reading only. The original idealist sustaining interpretation requires a separate semantic translation if it uses another direct or non-grounding relation. Neither silence about a support edge nor omission of an independence premise proves the negative horn.
